name: Parabolic Sphere Tracing
aliases: Analytical tracing in a single cell
definition: A ray tracing method where the ray trajectory is a second-order polynomial (parabola) because the squared refractive index (RIF) is defined as a linear function of position, resulting in a constant gradient of squared RIF.
summary: Parabolic Sphere Tracing analytically solves ray tracing within tetrahedral cells using parabolic trajectories, replacing iterative stepping with exact algebraic solutions when the squared refractive index gradient is constant.
